digest.component_or_area: CI checkout and tickets store initialization
propositions: Fresh full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall; partial clone with blob:none filter costs 68.7 MiB / 14.3s, a 15x reduction in size and time.
The tickets fetch in actions/checkout dominates CI runtime (237s measured); subsequent rebar init should inherit the partial clone filter but currently does not.
When tickets fetch times out or fails in rebar init, the fail-open fallback silently creates an orphan branch with empty store, causing silent divergence from origin/tickets and wrong empty reads.
blob:none partial clone preserves complete commit graph and is safe for merge-base / commit-ancestry scoping and tree-level diffs, avoiding shallow-clone graph truncation hazards.
The reconverge path materializes blobs from blobless history and requires merge.ours.driver=true on the runner to avoid degrading to text merge of 18 MB JSON files.

derive_caused_by must abort and return None on any per-path blame failure rather than tallying partial results, and resolve_event_commit / resolve_position_commit must handle signed commits correctly with log.showSignature=false.
